summary: The relevance gate, the debrief and the standing fold now call the model through the Agent SDK instead of hand-rolled raw completions.
details: Three of the four call sites that bypassed the SDK are back on it, through one seam in nora/agent/structured.py. They inherit the SDK's machinery instead of each carrying a different subset of it, and the instruction now goes in the system role with the transcript in the user role rather than both concatenated into one user message.
